Our client, SplashEZ, a fast-growing eCommerce company, operating in the USA, is searching for a talented and experienced Amazon Account Manager to join their team for a full time remote job. About the company SplashEZ is an outdoor and recreational brand on a mission to create the most exciting, functional, and high-quality products in the market.

From pool floats to premium boating accessories, we've made a splash with customers worldwide. As we continue to grow, were looking for an Amazon Brand Manager who is passionate about data, process, and creative problem solving to help us scale to new heights on Amazon.

About the Role As an Amazon Account Manager , you'll take ownership of key aspects of the company's Amazon day-to-day operations. From monitoring daily performance, managing listings, tracking keyword performance, and launching promotions this is an all-encompassing role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly organized environment.

This is a hands-on role where attention to detail, strong communication, and Amazon-savvy are key. Key Responsibilities: Track account health , keyword rankings , and product indexing. Stay on top of ClickUp tasks management, Slack, and email communications. Handle Amazon support cases , including calls when needed.

Maintain keyword tracking and DataDive niche dives. Create listings and use flat files for updates and catalog organization. Optimize titles, bullets, backend search terms. Upload new images, videos , and submit Brand Registry cases. Submit refund requests. Manage Lightning Deals, coupons, discounts , and Vine submissions.

Track the deal calendar , work with creators, and analyze results. Maintain templates and send weekly performance reports. Update keyword indexing and search volume. Create and analyze A/B polls. Qualifications: 2+ years experience in the managing Amazon Seller Central accounts.

Knowledgeable about optimizing listings with measurable keyword ranking improvements. Detail-oriented and analytical, with strong project management and organizational skills. Fluent in tools like ClickUp, DataDive, Datarova , and Amazon flat files. Excellent written and verbal communication. Proactive, self-motivated, and highly reliable.

Comfortable working remotely and managing multiple workflows at once. Comfortable working with Time Tracking software. Our benefits Work for a Market-proven, fast-growing company. Competitive salary. Supportive and friendly work environment. Be a part of something bigger, where you can have autonomy over your work.

Fully remote work and flexible working hours (work from whatever place). Originally posted on Himalayas

what you will do About Gnosis Pay Gnosis Pay provides the API and card-program infrastructure that enables wallets, fintechs, and businesses to issue stablecoin-powered payment cards and create custom payment flows. Partners can easily connect on-chain wallets to real-world spending.

With our technology, users can spend stablecoins directly from their on-chain wallet using a Visa debit card. Transactions are executed through a secure smart-wallet rather than a traditional bank account, allowing users to retain full custody of their assets while paying anywhere Visa is accepted.

Role Overview We're looking for an experienced Business Development Manager to accelerate Gnosis Pay's growth across Europe. This is a highly commercial, hunter-focused role.

Your primary responsibility will be identifying, engaging, negotiating, and closing new enterprise partnerships with leading fintechs, crypto companies, wallets, neobanks, and other financial platforms.

You'll own the entire sales cycle—from prospecting to signed agreements—and play a key role in expanding Gnosis Pay's enterprise customer base across the region.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced startup environments, enjoys building relationships with senior decision-makers, and has a proven ability to close complex enterprise deals. Key Responsibilities Enterprise Business Developement Identify, qualify, and close new enterprise partnerships across Europe.

Build and manage a healthy sales pipeline through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals, and industry events. Own the complete enterprise sales cycle, from first contact through contract negotiation and signature.

Develop relationships with C-level executives and senior stakeholders within fintech, crypto, payments, and financial services companies. Commercial Execution Understand customer needs and position Gnosis Pay's infrastructure as the preferred solution. Prepare and deliver commercial proposals tailored to each opportunity.

Lead commercial negotiations alongside internal legal, product, and compliance teams. Consistently achieve and exceed commercial targets. Market Development Represent Gnosis Pay at conferences, industry events, and networking opportunities across Europe. Build strong relationships within the European fintech and crypto ecosystem.

Continuously identify new market opportunities and strategic partnerships Market Intelligence Monitoring industry trends, competitive activities and emerging opportunities.

Share customer insights and market feedback to help shape product priorities and commercial strategies. who you are 5+ years of experience in Enterprise Sales, Business Development, or Strategic Partnerships. Proven track record of sourcing and closing high-value B2B enterprise deals.

Experience selling to fintechs, payment companies, crypto companies, digital wallets, banks, or financial institutions. Experience managing long and complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders. Strong negotiation and commercial relationship management skills.

Comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced startup environment. Excellent communication and presentation skills in English. Willingness to travel across Europe as needed. Preferred Qualifications Existing network within the European fintech and crypto ecosystem.

Experience selling API-based products, payment infrastructure, Banking-as-a-Service, card issuing, embedded finance, or similar financial infrastructure solutions. Familiarity with blockchain, stablecoins, digital assets, or crypto payments.

Previous experience in a high-growth fintech or Web3 company. what we can offer you Personal Development: Pursue your professional goals with our support, including personal education budgets and conference allowances. We invest in your growth and learning. Innovation and Experimentation: Interested in exploring new ideas?

Dedicate your Friday afternoons to research or work on a side project within our ecosystem. We encourage creativity and experimentation. Flat Hierarchy: Navigate with ease in our organization. Our flat hierarchy ensures your ideas and contributions are valued and heard, without getting lost in a complex structure.

Flexible and Remote Work: Not a morning person? No problem! We embrace flexible working schedules and have a long-standing culture of remote work. Balance your professional and personal life in a way that works for you. State-of-the-Art Equipment: Receive the latest hardware and all the tools you need.

We make sure you're well-equipped to do your best work. Growth and Opportunity: Grow with us in an exciting industry. As Gnosis rapidly expands, so do the opportunities for you to make a significant impact. We value initiative and a proactive approach.

Community and Mission: Join a team that's passionate about our mission and enjoys working together. We’re not just colleagues; we’re a community driven by a shared goal. At Gnosis , we strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our team members.

We believe that our products and services benefit from our diverse backgrounds and experiences and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer: all qualified applicants are considered for positions regardless of race, ethnic origin, age, religion or belief, marital status, gender identification, sexual orientation, or physical ability.

Description Commercial Account Executive (Nordics) Nordics (Remote) About The Position Upwind is a next-generation Cloud Security Platform that leverages runtime context to identify and prioritize critical risks, providing precise insights and efficient cloud security management.

Unlike traditional tools, Upwind uses runtime data proactively for risk prioritization and posture insights, ensuring teams focus on what truly matters.

With industry-leading efficiency and eBPF-powered sensors, Upwind delivers comprehensive capabilities, including agentless cloud posture discovery, real-time threat protection, and integrated API security. From misconfigurations to malware defense, Upwind ensures end-to-end, cost-effective cloud infrastructure protection.

At Upwind, you’ll have the opportunity to think creatively, explore new ideas, and use your skills to make a meaningful impact on our growth. We are seeing strong demand for Upwind across Nordics and Baltics.

We are looking for an experienced Commercial Account Executive to join our team of experienced sellers that is deeply committed to building meaningful relationships with customers and partners, focusing on their value and thinking strategically about bringing deals to close. ﻿Responsibilities
Develop and execute a comprehensive sales strategy to identify and generate new business pipeline, exceed revenue targets, and win new enterprise logos
Demonstrate a thorough understanding of customer needs, challenges, and business objectives to effectively position Upwind’s solution with C-level executives and technical stakeholders
Partner closely with technical teams to ensure seamless integration and implementation to accelerate the time-to-value realization for clients
Lead and execute end-to-end sales cycles with excellence in all phases: from pipeline generation and opportunity qualification to the creation and delivery of a quantifiable business case / ROI justification
Collaborate and build trusted relationships with Upwind channel partners and ecosystem to expand and optimize market reach
Lead contract negotiations to completion and successful closure

Proven track record of driving and closing commercial deals
Strong working knowledge of cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), serverless technologies, and modern application development lifecycles (CI/CD). Familiarity with CNAPP components (e.g., CSPM, KSPM, CIEM, Cloud Workload Protection) is highly desirable.
Strong understanding of cloud security concepts, technologies, and trends preferred
Ability to effectively sell to both C-level executives and technical stakeholders in Cloud / Security / DevOps
Consistent achievement of quota and revenue targets
Familiarity and experience utilizing proven qualification methodologies (e.g. MEDDPICC) and a disciplined sales process
Maintain accurate forecasting and reporting of the business to leadership and embrace a data-driven approach to SFDC hygiene
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Self-motivated, results-driven, collaborative, and adaptable to keep up in a very fast-paced, rapidly changing, startup environment

About Emerald Emerald ’s talented and experienced teams grow our customers’ businesses 365 days a year with products that create connections, deliver content, and drive commerce.

We produce over 140 annual events, create and deliver content through print and digital channels, and power commerce through our seamlessly integrated in-person and digital platforms and channels.

For more information, please visit ASD Market Week is one of the largest and longest-running business-to-business general merchandise trade shows in the United States.

Held twice annually in Las Vegas, ASD connects thousands of retailers, distributors, importers, and e-commerce businesses with manufacturers, wholesalers, and suppliers from around the world.

With more than 1,800 vendors, approximately 30,000 attendees, and over one million products across 19+ merchandise categories, ASD provides exhibitors with a powerful platform to meet new customers, enter new markets, build brand visibility, and write business directly on the show floor.

We are seeking a motivated, commercially driven Account Executive to grow exhibitor and sponsorship revenue for ASD Market Week. The Account Executive will manage the complete sales cycle—from identifying and prospecting new business opportunities through discovery, proposal development, negotiation, closing, and renewal.

This role will primarily engage manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, importers, suppliers, and consumer-product brands that would benefit from reaching ASD’s diverse community of retail buyers.

The successful candidate will be a proactive new-business hunter who is comfortable conducting high-volume outbound prospecting, building relationships with senior decision-makers, and presenting tailored event solutions that deliver measurable value to customers. Key Responsibilities New Business Development
Identify and prospect manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, suppliers, and emerging brands that align with ASD Market Week’s buyer community.
Generate new business through telephone outreach, email campaigns, LinkedIn, industry research, referrals, inbound leads, networking, and competitive-event prospecting.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified exhibit and sponsorship opportunities.
Develop targeted prospecting strategies across relevant product categories, including general merchandise, fashion and accessories, beauty and wellness, gift and home, toys, convenience-store products, closeouts, liquidation, and private-label manufacturing.
Re-engage dormant, lapsed, and previously lost exhibitors with relevant and compelling commercial proposals.
Consultative Sales and Closing
Own the full sales cycle from initial outreach and qualification through proposal, negotiation, contracting, and close.
Conduct effective discovery conversations to understand each prospect’s products, target customers, business objectives, challenges, and growth strategy.
Clearly communicate ASD Market Week’s value proposition and demonstrate how participation can help customers generate leads, meet qualified buyers, enter new markets, increase brand visibility, and grow revenue.
Recommend appropriate booth packages, sponsorships, digital products, marketing opportunities, and other solutions based on customer needs and objectives.
Prepare proposals, negotiate commercial terms, overcome objections, create urgency, and consistently move opportunities toward close.
Meet or exceed individual revenue, new-business, renewal, activity, and productivity targets.
Account Growth and Retention
Develop strong relationships with new and existing exhibitors, serving as a knowledgeable and trusted commercial partner.
Manage a portfolio of assigned accounts and identify opportunities for renewal, expansion, upselling, cross-selling, and multi-show participation.
Conduct structured post-show follow-up to review exhibitor outcomes, gather feedback, address concerns, and secure future participation.
Work proactively to reduce cancellations and improve exhibitor retention.
Maintain regular communication with customers throughout the event cycle to ensure expectations are clearly understood and appropriately managed.
Pipeline Management and Forecasting
Maintain complete and accurate customer, activity, opportunity, and contract information within the CRM.
Manage opportunities through clearly defined pipeline stages with documented next steps and realistic close dates.
Produce accurate weekly and monthly sales forecasts.
Monitor personal pacing against revenue goals, activity expectations, and event deadlines.
Use CRM data, category insights, sales reports, and market intelligence to prioritize accounts and identify areas of opportunity.
Maintain strong pipeline discipline and immediately escalate material risks, blockers, or forecast changes.
Collaboration and Event Delivery
Partner closely with marketing, operations, customer success, finance, and event leadership to deliver a strong exhibitor experience.
Provide customer and marketplace feedback to support product development, pricing, marketing campaigns, and show-floor strategy.
Coordinate the successful handoff of contracted exhibitors to the appropriate operational and customer-success teams.
Attend ASD Market Week and other relevant industry events, supporting customers onsite and developing new sales opportunities.
Represent ASD and Emerald professionally in all customer and industry interactions.

Two or more years of successful B2B sales, business development, account management, media sales, event sales, or sponsorship sales experience.
Demonstrated ability to generate new business through proactive outbound prospecting.
Proven record of meeting or exceeding individual sales targets.
Experience managing the complete sales cycle from prospecting through negotiation and close.
Strong consultative-selling, presentation, negotiation, and objection-handling skills.
Ability to build credibility and relationships with business owners, founders, sales leaders, marketing executives, and other senior decision-makers.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage a high volume of accounts, opportunities, and deadlines.
Experience using CRM and sales-enablement platforms; Salesforce experience is preferred.
Strong forecasting discipline and attention to CRM accuracy.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, target-driven, and deadline-oriented sales environment.
Ability and willingness to travel to ASD Market Week in Las Vegas and other relevant industry events.
Trade-show, wholesale, retail, consumer-products, media, or events-industry experience is preferred but not required.

s.t:

Building a strong and sustainable pipeline of new exhibitor opportunities.
Expanding ASD’s presence across priority merchandise categories and markets.
Converting qualified prospects into contracted exhibitors and sponsors.
Retaining and growing existing accounts.
Maintaining accurate forecasting and disciplined CRM management.

At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes.

Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.
Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

ExtraHop is redefining cyber defense for the AI era. As an innovator and leader, we help organizations secure the transition to the "Agentic Enterprise" by defending against AI-powered attacks while delivering full visibility across their AI estate.

We turn the network into "Decision-Grade Intelligence"—the high-fidelity context that enables security teams to detect threats, investigate faster, and respond at machine speed. If you are an experienced sales professional who thrives in the security market and can help customers navigate the transition to an Agentic SOC, we want to hear from you.

Articulate the value of the 'Agentic Enterprise' and the need for decision-grade intelligence to drive security outcomes.
Help customers transition from reactive, disconnected alerts to proactive, autonomous workflows within their SOC.
Sell the platform's unique ability to provide visibility across the entire AI estate, including traffic patterns and AI-model interactions.
Demonstrate how ExtraHop serves as the foundational 'source of truth' for both human analysts and autonomous AI agents.
Identify opportunities to solve for modern threats, including AI-powered attacks, identity-based attacks, and shadow AI usage.
Prepare and implement strategic sales account plans for all customers and identify business growth opportunities in assigned customer base
Ensure resellers and field sales engineers and management are working together in the sales process, lead generation, registering opportunities, accurately forecasting revenue, and tracking to required revenue goals established by their discount tier
Work with resellers to grow business in your territory
Prepare and maintain an accurate sales forecast for your territory
Network in customer and related organizations

Three years' security sales experience

Strong communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills

Experience mapping sales strategy to business outcomes like reduced mean time to detect/respond and improved security ROI.

Background in software/hardware sales and distribution with large software, hardware, and/or networking companies

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution.

By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.
This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response.

(NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world. In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills. Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer. Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it. Our company values guide our daily actions:

Safe : We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.

Committed to Serve : We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.

Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.

Driven : We deliver results in the right way.

Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.
We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants.

These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods. STRATEGY Republic Services ’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth.

Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets. We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities.

And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers. Recycling and Waste We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions.

The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.

Environmental Solutions Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth. The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility.

These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity.

We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.

Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy.

Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year). RECENT RECOGNITION

NetBox Labs is seeking a Channel Account Manager (CAM) to play a key role in the growth and expansion of our partner business. You will report to the VP of Partnerships. Your mandate is simple to state and demanding to execute: drive NetBox Labs revenue by making our partners a force multiplier for our sales team.

That means hunting for partner opportunities, owning a partner-sourced pipeline, and expanding and deepening our existing partner relationships. This requires you to enable partner sellers to find, position, and win with NetBox Labs across our critical VAR, SI, and Technology Partner channels, from large national VARs to strong regional players.

We are looking for a hungry, high-energy doer; the person who makes things happen. The right candidate is a proven self-starter with initiative and self-sufficiency: someone who builds their own plan, creates their own momentum, and delivers results without waiting for direction.
Two things make this seat distinctive. First, the motion: this is a scaling business with real deal flow, a very active, fast-moving environment closing dozens of deals every quarter. As our platform adds new features and capabilities, we are winning larger and more complex enterprise deals.

You need to keep pace with today’s velocity and bring the experience to help us win upmarket. Second, the team: our sales organization is early in its career and growing fast. We need a CAM whose experience raises the whole team's game; co-selling, coaching deal strategy, and sharing hard-won channel craft.

Everything at NetBox Labs is new, and it changes daily. This role rewards curiosity, adaptability, and the commitment to put in the time to master our platform, our open source community, and our market. Experience here is a foundation to build on — never a playbook to coast on.
In this role you will
Hunt for revenue: prospect relentlessly for new opportunities within and alongside our partners; work with partner sellers and our sales organization to uncover, register, and advance deals in their account bases, bringing the same drive to partner-sourced pipeline that a top seller brings to net-new logos.
Selectively expand the partner portfolio: we are always open to new partners, especially large ones, but our team is lean and we qualify rigorously. Evaluate inbound and prospective partners with discipline, and work with the partner team to onboard only those that meaningfully strengthen our coverage.
Map and develop relationships within the Partner Field and Field Technical organizations: relentlessly discover new contacts, turn them into Champions for NetBox Labs, and convert those relationships into sales opportunities.
Own the number: build, forecast, and be accountable for a robust pipeline of Partner Sourced sales opportunities, and co-sell alongside our Account Executives to move deals from registration to close — at the pace our deal flow demands.
Coach as you close: co-sell with our Account Executives, run deal reviews, and share your channel knowledge and deal instincts that only experience teaches.
Drive joint go-to-market execution: build partner business plans, launch sales campaigns and enablement with partners, and hold both sides accountable for pipeline commitments.
Facilitate the effective and efficient interaction of NetBox Labs field and field technical teams with their counterparts at our partner organizations. Develop and maintain executive relationships with assigned Partners.
Learn relentlessly: invest the time to master the NetBox Labs platform, our open source ecosystem, and the network automation market — and keep learning as the product, the motion, and the market change week to week.
Keep Partner and Partner Deal information accurate and up to date within our CRM system. Provide accurate and timely reporting on key partner indicators and metrics.

Minimum of 3 – 5 years of channel sales experience, with a strong emphasis on managing Value-Added Resellers (VARs), SIs, Boutique consulting firms, and Technology partners in the B2B high-tech space (SaaS, networking, Infrastructure, cybersecurity, etc.).
Proven success in growing and managing a portfolio of partners with a measurable revenue impact: you can point to the pipeline you sourced and deals you helped close.
A strong sales orientation and hunter mentality: hungry, energetic, and treats partner recruitment and pipeline generation the way a quota-carrying seller treats their number.
A demonstrated self-starter who shows initiative and self-sufficiency: you thrive with autonomy, create your own structure, and do not need hand-holding to deliver results.
Range across deal types: you thrive in a very active, fast-moving, deal-rich environment, and you have the skills and mindset for larger, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals as that mix grows.
A coach’s mindset: genuine enjoyment in collaborating with sellers; you measure your impact in the team’s numbers, not just your own.
Learning agility: you quickly master new products, ecosystems, and markets, and you are energized, not exhausted, by an environment where everything is new and changes daily.
Start-up attitude: Ability to prioritize and act on the most important activities while working as a team to respond. Collaboration/coordination with your peers is the key to success. We are extremely fast paced.
Embrace AI: Leveraging AI to accelerate partnerships and add efficiency to your activities will be key. AI allows us to move / respond quickly.

About Cytix
Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on.
That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.
We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.
Make the first move . When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.
Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.
See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.
Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.
Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory.

The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.
The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts.

The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow-through.

Territory Strategy & Business Performance
Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.
Strategic Account Management & Network Development
Identify, prioritize, and develop high-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow-through.
Map influence and decision-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.
Clinical Aptitude & Customer Engagement
Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.
Influence & Impact
Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries
Customer, Patient & Caregiver Impact

Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
Where and how you can work
Our flagship office is in Sydney, Australia, but we've made our way from down under, to a campus in Austin, Texas which is now home to our US operations. This role is fully remote based in Chicago.

Our Sales and Success team support Canva Enterprise, with the mission to empower every organization to design. Canva Enterprise lets organizations consolidate design, content production, and collaboration tools under one secure and centralized account. From whiteboards to docs, to presentations and our AI platform magic Studio, our Sales team work with all departments empowering them to create and collaborate at scale.

Our team consists of experienced Account Executives who have a passion for building relationships with customers who love our product.
Our Account Executives work closely with our customers to understand their goals and provide tailored solutions to meet their needs. Whether it's creating eye-catching pitch decks for their sales teams, designing creative marketing materials at scale, or ensuring everyone is on-brand, our team has the expertise to help our customers in all departments succeed.
We're teaming up with colleagues across the board - from Product to Marketing - all supporting our sales team. As we branch out into new markets and develop fresh Enterprise solutions, we're crafting something truly unique. Together, we're redesigning work.

Account Planning: You will lead with a data-driven approach to identify and reach out to potential customers who are likely to benefit from Canva 's products. Analyze market landscapes, trends, and dynamics to translate high-level plans into targeted sales activities.
Managing Pipeline + Revenue Growth: You will manage pipeline, revenue forecasts, sales activity using Salesforce for maximum efficiency and visibility
Customer Centric: You will leverage compelling storytelling and vision transfer, presented through a creative lens, to guide customers on a journey that feels personalized and right for them.
Be a product expert: Exhibit a deep love for Canva ’s product and an ability to sell creative solutions that address customers’ unique problems. You will gather customer feedback and convey market needs to inform the Product roadmap and provide insights that strengthen our value proposition and enhance the customer experience
Foster long-term relationships: Recognize the value of building long-term relationships and strive to create lasting partnerships both with customers and internal cross functional teams (Product, Eng, Post-Sales, Customer Success).
Bring chaos to clarity: Simplifying complex situations into digestible customer-ready stories and materials using Canva ’s worksuite (presentations, doc etc.)

8+ years of full cycle selling experience working with a range of customers, from medium-sized businesses to large corporations. For our Strategic role, we are looking for people with experience with large named accounts ideally on a global scale within a technology company, demonstrating a history of top performance.
You have proven success managing a full sales cycle, including prospecting with a focus on new logo attainment.
You’re a pro at navigating complexity by understanding and addressing complex business challenges, crafting solutions.
You've got a talent for creating detailed plans that cover all the bases within intricate organizations.
You've got the skills to captivate an audience, especially during face-to-face meetings with multiple key players.
You've got a track record of leading successful (and complex) negotiations.
You're comfortable navigating uncertainty and can keep up in a fast-paced environment.
What's in it for you?
Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva , too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

About Rescale
Rescale is pioneering the future of engineering and scientific discovery. As the leader in digital engineering, we help the world’s most advanced organizations develop better products faster through intelligent automation, applied AI, data management, and access to the world’s largest network of engineering and R&D applications.
Rescale brings together elastic, enterprise-grade HPC with advanced modeling and simulation, agentic engineering, AI Physics, and the software and data workflows that connect them. Our customers use Rescale to modernize R&D, accelerate simulation, automate engineering processes, and turn engineering data into faster, better decisions across industries including automotive, manufacturing, aerospace, energy, life sciences, and semiconductors.
Joining Rescale means becoming part of a diverse, collaborative, and mission-driven team solving complex challenges that traditional HPC alone cannot address.

We are looking for a high-performing Strategic Account Executive to lead direct enterprise sales and account growth across France.
This is an entrepreneurial, field-based role focused on building and expanding strategic relationships with key and enterprise accounts. You will own a defined portfolio of named accounts, create demand, develop executive relationships, win new business, and expand Rescale’s footprint from foundational HPC into advanced modeling and simulation, agentic engineering, and AI Physics.
You will operate as the commercial owner of your territory: setting the account strategy, identifying business problems, building internal champions, creating compelling value cases, and leading complex sales cycles from first engagement through renewal and expansion. This is a direct-sales role, not a channel-led position.

You will work closely with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Sales Development, Product, and Rescale leadership, while retaining ownership of the commercial strategy and outcome.
France is a priority market, with particular emphasis on automotive and manufacturing enterprises where engineering organizations are investing in digital engineering transformation. Success requires the ability to sell both into existing strategic relationships and into new enterprise accounts where Rescale can create meaningful business impact.

Own and grow a focused portfolio of strategic key and enterprise accounts across France.
Build account and territory plans that identify the highest-value expansion paths, whitespace, executive relationships, and competitive risks.
Expand existing Rescale customers by introducing additional capabilities across the platform, from Rescale HPC to Advanced Modeling and Simulation, Agentic Engineering, and AI Physics.
Develop new enterprise relationships and win new logos where Rescale’s platform can transform engineering and R&D workflows.
Generate pipeline through proactive prospecting, account-based engagement, executive networking, customer insight, and disciplined market development.
Engage senior stakeholders across engineering, R&D, simulation, IT, digital transformation, finance, procurement, and executive leadership.
Lead the full enterprise sales cycle, including account planning, discovery, qualification, value engineering, business-case development, solution alignment, negotiation, procurement, and close.
Position Rescale as a strategic platform for HPC modernization, simulation acceleration, engineering workflow transformation, and AI-driven product development.
Articulate how Rescale’s offerings work together: HPC as the scalable foundation; Advanced Modeling and Simulation as the workflow layer; Agentic Engineering as the automation layer; and AI Physics as the intelligence layer that turns simulation data into predictive insight.
Build trusted relationships across the customer organization, from end users and technical champions to business sponsors, procurement leaders, and C-level decision-makers.
Orchestrate internal teams to deliver coordinated account plans, executive engagement, technical validation, pilots, and commercial proposals.
Maintain rigorous Salesforce hygiene, forecast accuracy, opportunity inspection, and pipeline coverage, with clear weekly visibility into commit, likely, best case, and risk.
Represent Rescale in customer meetings, industry events, and executive forums across France, with travel expected at approximately 30%.
What Success Looks Like
Consistent achievement and overachievement of quarterly and annual revenue targets through a healthy mix of account expansion and net-new enterprise business.
Durable growth within strategic accounts, including broader adoption of Rescale’s platform and expansion into new teams, workloads, geographies, and use cases.
A high-quality, self-generated pipeline across automotive, manufacturing, and other engineering-intensive industries.
New enterprise logos and meaningful strategic wins in the French market.
Executive-level credibility with customers navigating HPC modernization, simulation, AI, and digital engineering transformation.
Clear customer value cases that connect technical outcomes to business priorities such as faster product development, higher engineering productivity, improved infrastructure flexibility, and better R&D economics.
Consistent operating discipline, urgency, ownership, resilience, and transparency in a high-growth environment.

An entrepreneurial enterprise seller who creates opportunity rather than waiting for inbound demand.
Equally comfortable expanding an established strategic account and opening a new enterprise relationship.
A strong hunter with the persistence and commercial judgment to create access, build consensus, and win competitive deals.
Confident engaging technical practitioners while earning credibility with senior business leaders and executives.
Resilient and resourceful in long, complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
Commercially disciplined and accountable for your number, account strategy, forecast, pipeline quality, and execution.
Consultative, curious, and able to translate complex technology into compelling business outcomes.
Collaborative and low-ego, with the influence to mobilize cross-functional teams without losing ownership of the result.
Motivated by the opportunity to help define a new category at the intersection of cloud HPC, digital engineering, automation, and AI.

5+ years of success in enterprise or strategic account sales, ideally selling complex technical, cloud, SaaS, platform, engineering, or scientific-computing solutions.
Demonstrated success growing enterprise accounts and/or winning new business in France.
Experience selling to large organizations in automotive, manufacturing, industrial technology, engineering software, simulation, HPC, cloud, or adjacent technology environments.
A track record of managing long, complex, multi-threaded enterprise sales cycles from discovery through close and expansion.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

As a Senior Partner Sales Manager for Systems Integrators at Anthropic, you'll own a portfolio of global and regional SI partners and be responsible for the revenue they drive.
